name: tavli
description: Tavli dev environment — Node 22, pnpm, Convex/Vite tooling

init_hook: command -v droast >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'droast not found (used by the Dockerfile-edit hook, not packaged in nixpkgs) — install: brew tap immanuwell/droast https://github.com/immanuwell/homebrew-droast.git && brew install immanuwell/droast/droast'
